prs.title: fix: 5 bugs from session code review (race, tiers, joins)
feat: persist Tides Tracker stats cache to Postgres (CAMP-9)
feat: post thumbnails on the client report (CAMP-76)
feat: creator PFPs in the dossier (CAMP-76 v1)
feat: Run Now buttons wired to scrape trigger (CAMP-22)
feat: per-creator rollup + All Activity section (CAMP-34 final)
feat: Rising Tides Tracker + Booker dashboard pages (CAMP-34 frontend)
feat: booker-axis rollups w/ name normalization (CAMP-34 backend)
feat: label-axis attribution rollup — Warner vs Atlantic (CAMP-38, P0)
perf: cache the /cobrand live fetch + tighten timeout (CAMP-56)
feat: staggered row entrance on Creator Database + campaigns table
